en.headline: Woman dies after falling onto Po Loi Street pavement in Hung Hom
en.dek: Police said a 45-year-old woman was found on the ground outside 50 Po Loi Street shortly after 7:40am on Saturday and was certified dead at the scene.
body: A woman died after falling onto the pavement in Hung Hom on Saturday morning, police said.

Officers received a report at about 7:40am that a woman was lying on the ground outside 50 Po Loi Street. Rescue personnel confirmed she was dead at the scene, and police erected a tent to cover the body.
Initial information indicated the woman was 45 years old. Police went to a multi-storey car park in a nearby building to investigate her identity and the circumstances of the fall.

zh.headline: 紅磡寶來街女子墮樓倒臥行人路 當場不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六早上約7時40分接報，一名45歲女子倒臥寶來街50號對開行人路，經證實當場死亡。
body: 一名女子周六早上在紅磡寶來街墮樓，倒臥行人路，經救援人員證實當場不治。
警方約於早上7時40分接獲報案，指一名女子倒臥寶來街50號對開地面，懷疑從高處墮下。警方在場搭起帳篷遮蓋遺體。
據初步了解，死者為45歲女子。警方到鄰近大廈多層停車場調查，以追查身分及了解墮樓原因。
